title: Seven Factor's "Two Minutes of Hate" is an anthem of high-energy
htmlContent: Industrial meets metal on Seven Factor's new single "Two Minutes of Hate," which serves as a further building block for what will ultimately become the band's debut LP, "Room 101," due this Halloween. Seven Factor has already garnered national interest with their unique blend of charge and deeper storytelling, and this single is a perfect example of why. "Two Minutes of Hate" bristles with propulsive energy, catapulting you into a dystopian universe where rage and resistance are the only currencies worth having. https://youtu.be/_wva9IS4Ow8 This project is a relentlessly compelling combination of grinding industrial textures and metal intensity. Each release is part of a larger narrative, one that challenges you to examine the structures of control and conformity that surround them. The accompanying visuals only heighten that message, providing an immersive experience that feels as urgent as it does discomfiting. It's art intended to prompt people to think, as much as it is designed to get hearts racing. With "Two Minutes of Hate," Seven Factor is making a statement. It's forceful, unapologetic, and the surest signal yet that "Room 101" will be a revolution. Connect with Seven Factor on Instagram
